name: live-mcp
description: MCP server for Ableton Live, running inside Live as an extension

scripts.package: npm run build && ableton-extensions-cli package && mkdir -p release && mv -f Live-MCP-*.ablx release/ && npm run package:bridge
scripts.package:bridge: rm -f release/LiveRemote.zip && cd remote && zip -qr ../release/LiveRemote.zip LiveRemote -x '*/__pycache__/*' '*/.*'
